name: deck-changed
body: Event: a file changed while serving — under slides/, assets/, kalide.yaml, or anywhere under the resolved library root (the configured `templates:` path, else the local `templates/`; library.yaml, slides/, sections/, themes/, media/). Published (debounced) by watch-deck; triggers templates reload → validate → render. A change to the configured `templates:` value is a distinct restart-required condition: it does not retarget the library root, and the server shows the full-page restart-required error (see template-retarget-requires-restart).
